verses.english: “These two things play a part in realization.
What is the benefit of developing serenity?
What is the benefit of developing the mind?
What is the benefit of developing discernment?
What is the benefit of developing wisdom?

verses.pali: Rāgupakkiliṭṭhaṁ vā, bhikkhave, cittaṁ na vimuccati, avijjupakkiliṭṭhā vā paññā na bhāvīyati.
verses.english: The mind corrupted by greed is not free; and wisdom corrupted by ignorance does not grow.

verses.pali: Iti kho, bhikkhave, rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī”ti.
verses.english: In this way, freedom of heart comes from the fading away of greed, while freedom by wisdom comes from the fading away of ignorance.”
